request: Analyze GSE277819 for PMID 40839394 (Molecular signatures underlying heterogenous hypertrophy responsiveness to resistance training in older men and women: a within-subject design.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, human vastus lateralis (Illumina NovaSeq 6000; STAR GRCh38 + featureCounts)
final.primary_estimand: Within-subject transcriptome change in vastus lateralis after 10 weeks of unilateral resistance training (2x/week) at low volume (1 set, one leg) and high volume (4 sets, contralateral leg) versus the pre-training biopsy, analyzed by hypertrophy-responder phenotype (low / medium / high responders defined from qCSA change vs 2xTE = 3.27%)
final.repeated_measure_unit: participant (27 older men and women; 3 biopsies each)
final.sample_inclusion: 27 older participants (69 +/- 3 yr) from the parental trial; biopsies at baseline and 48 h after the last session from both legs (abstract; GEO overall_design)
planned_contrasts: post-1set vs baseline within each responder group (abstract: high responders hypertrophy after both volumes; low responders no pathway changes)
post-4sets vs baseline within each responder group (abstract)
4 sets vs 1 set (abstract: higher volume increased Frizzled-1 protein, regardless of responder group)
final.paper_method: RNA-seq GO analysis and PLIER pathway analysis (abstract); DE software and threshold not stated in the abstract
final.paper_results: pathway-level only: high responders up-regulated protein turnover / RT metabolic / protein-folding pathways; medium responders down-regulated proteasome and spliceosome; low responders no measurable pathway change. No DEG counts in the abstract. Frizzled-1 is a protein (western blot) result.

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Full text not available; plan reconstructed from the PubMed abstract (efetch PMID 40839394) and the GEO series summary/overall_design. Both name GSE277819 and the 1-set vs 4-sets within-subject design.
paper_reconstruction.locator: PubMed abstract; GEO GSE277819 Series_summary / Series_overall_design

checks: series title matches the paper title
81 samples = 27 participants x 3 biopsies, as the overall design describes
matrix GSE277819_raw_counts.txt.gz has 81 columns matching all 81 sample titles

ownership.reasoning: The series is the paper's deposit; the supplementary counts matrix covers exactly the 81 GSMs.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns A_102 / BD_102 / BE_102 equal the GEO titles A102 / BD102 / BE102 ignoring the underscore (inspect: 81/81 via normalize_keys). subject = 'P_<participant id>' so the blocking factor is never read as numeric; condition recoded to BL/S1/S4. Prefixes A/BD/BE are biopsy labels; the condition field (not the prefix) defines the leg's volume, because BD/BE are randomized legs.

matrix.reasoning: 100% integers, max 1.9e6, median 0; GEO data_processing: STAR + featureCounts, 'Tab-delimited raw read counts matrix'.

design.subject: subject

candidates.reason_rejected: responder allocation is not in GEO metadata and the per-participant qCSA changes are not available (abstract only), so the groups cannot be reconstructed; pooled within-subject contrasts are run as a declared deviation
BD/BE are leg labels with randomized volume; the condition characteristic gives the volume

design.reasoning: All 27 participants contribute baseline, post-1set and post-4sets biopsies; one model with subject blocking gives the two training effects vs baseline and the volume effect (4 vs 1, both legs post-training within subject).

covariance.reasoning: Three biopsies per participant (within-subject design per the series title and overall design); subject is the blocking factor. No batch or sex column is deposited; no covariates added by name.

paper_route.method: unstated DE method + GO / PLIER, stratified by responder group
paper_route.reason: abstract does not state the DE method; responder labels not deposited

deviations: pooled across responder groups instead of per-group
DESeq2 on raw featureCounts chosen by workflow (paper method unknown)

method.reasoning: Raw integer counts support DESeq2; paired design via subject term.

final.deviation_note: The abstract reports only pathway results; workflow default BH padj < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff.

threshold.reasoning: No threshold in the abstract or GEO record.

caveats: Comparison with the paper rests on the abstract and GEO description only (no full text).

Paper analyses are by responder group; ours pool all 27 participants, so responder-specific signatures (high: protein turnover/folding up; medium: proteasome/spliceosome down; low: none) cannot be checked directly.
Frizzled-1 (FZD1) result in the paper is protein; mRNA lookup is only indicative.

study.reasoning: No DEG counts in the abstract; FZD1 looked up in the volume contrast.

discrepancies.data: GEO has no responder or qCSA field
